assertion_review.durability_limit: No test is committed and the node's write paths carry no test file, which is correct for an evidence fragment; the guards live inside the script that also produces the artefact, so two of the eight assertion families cannot fail, and a classifier change plus a matching checker change would still be internally consistent. The negative-control log is therefore the only falsification evidence, and it covers three of the guards.

1.reason: the live guard is check_document_assignments, which the review confirms; the same-process cost check is a redundant assertion, not a claimed control

2.reason: check_document_assignments at :351 is the real one-class-per-item guard and is what the plan names; the Counter sums are reported alongside it, not instead of it

4.reason: comments in a committed evidence runner under docs/evidence cite the node that produced the figures as data provenance; the figures are restated in prose beside them

non-blocking: check_cost_basis compares the emitted cohort figures and their derived per-named rate with the same module constants that cost_basis() built them from in the same process, so the branch 'the emission refuses a basis whose figures disagree with the recorded run' claimed by commit 9788064fd cannot fire; only the absent-block branch at :402 is a live guard, which is what negative-control.log nc2 exercises.

non-blocking: the class-sum guards at :635 and :637 compare each Counter's sum with len() of the population it was incremented once per item over, so they hold for any classification, yet :691-696 publishes those two sums in the document's reconciliation block as the evidence that every item is in exactly one class; the real guard is check_document_assignments at :351.

non-blocking: a source whose status is terminal 'failed' is classed attempt-capped whether or not it reached the five-attempt claim cap, so the class holds 43 rows at 5, 34 at 4, 11 at 3 and 2 at 6 attempts, and 56 of the 90 carry the parked disposition cause_not_recorded; the class name asserts a cause the census never established for the sub-cap rows, though the per-row parked field does disclose it.

justifications.durability: The guards that can fail are real and were shown firing: assign_class refuses an item in zero or two classes (negative-control.log nc3, exit 1), check_document_assignments compares the emitted lists against the class membership derived from the read (nc1, exit 1) and refuses an empty population at :396, while the cost-agreement branch at :410 and the class-sum guard at :635 cannot fail because both sides are produced by the same computation.
justifications.evidence: census-gate.log records EXIT=0 at the gate revision with totals matching the plan's 6123/5203/920/116, and negative-control.log shows three scratch reversions each exiting 1 at the check they defeat, but part of the asserted evidence is the code checking its own output: sib-unaccepted-census-run.py:410 compares the emitted cost basis with the same module constants that built it, and :635/:637 compare each class Counter's sum with len() of the collection it was incremented from.
justifications.fit: The script follows the evidence-fragment idiom of its siblings (a node-named <node>-run.py beside <node>.json/.html, node-prefixed ids, import of product constants rather than restated thresholds), but sib-unaccepted-census-run.py:299 and :307 cite a plan node id and a plan section number in comments, which the repository naming rules forbid in source.
justifications.goal_fidelity: sib-unaccepted-census-run.py:252 (assign_class) plus the rule tables at :179 and :237 assign every one of the 920 sources and 116 names to exactly one class and the emitted JSON carries them (verified: 920/919-distinct and 116/116), but the name population's step and scope at :650-651 come from the source-oriented CLASS_STEPS at :60, so an exhausted name marked 'refused by a writer' is told its advancing step is 'compose (the candidate was refused at write time)' scoped 'by source_id' when its own row shows docs accepted and a validation quarantine.
justifications.reuse: The census reuses DEFAULT_MIN_SCORE, _MAX_COMPOSE_CLAIM_ATTEMPTS and graph_source_bindings.classify_parked_source/CAP_PARKED_DISPOSITIONS instead of restating the floor, the cap or the parked triage; my search over imas_codex/standard_names for an existing per-item blocking-class owner found only count-level instruments (graph_claim_scope.pipeline_buckets, cost_model, graph_source_bindings.census_parked_dispositions), none of which assigns a blocking class per unaccepted source, so the added table is the first owner of that capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 197de19cd1..b67a1f0e09 lists only the three assigned fragment files, with no plan edit, no product source and no generated model touched, and the HTML element ids are prefixed with sib-unaccepted-census per the fragment contract.
